quotes.name: Marguerite Kimball-Ostrow
quotes.quote: I didn't really have a strategy on Wednesday night. I just flew through the systems one by one, and it happened to come out even on credits. I wasn't really focusing on that; I was just trying to explore and see where the show would take me.
